protocol_mismatch.title: F.R.I.D.A.Y. agent protocol mismatch
protocol_mismatch.description: The F.R.I.D.A.Y. agent speaks a protocol version this integration does not support. Update the integration or the agent so both use the same protocol.

user.title: F.R.I.D.A.Y.
user.description: Add the F.R.I.D.A.Y. integration. Add the server and satellites afterwards as devices of this entry.

zeroconf_confirm.title: F.R.I.D.A.Y. satellite found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Satellite at {host}. Enter its local-port password and, optionally, the area.

pair.title: Satellite {id}
pair.description: Enter the 4-digit code the satellite is speaking.

abort.reauth_successful: Satellite adopted again with a new token.

error.locked: Too many attempts: the satellite spoke a new code.

data_description.token: The agent token from the server (never shared outside Home Assistant).
data_description.proxmox_token_secret: Leave blank to keep the stored value. The Reboot VM button appears only when all Proxmox fields are filled.

data_description.token: Leave blank to keep the stored token.
data_description.proxmox_token_secret: Leave blank to keep the stored value. The Reboot VM button appears only when all Proxmox fields are filled.

data_description.token: The satellite's local-port password (never shared outside Home Assistant).
Leave blank to keep the stored token.

wifi.title: Change Wi-Fi
wifi.description: The satellite joins the new network; if it does not answer within a minute, it goes back to the previous one. The password is not stored.

room_sensors.title: Room sensors
room_sensors.description: Where the room temperature and humidity come from. Leave a source empty to keep that sensor unavailable. The entity is used only with the Home Assistant entity source.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Engineering settings of this satellite. Only the values you change are sent.

data_description.ducking_restore: How long until the music volume comes back

abort.wifi_changed: Wi-Fi change started; the result appears in the logbook and in the Wi-Fi change sensor.
abort.advanced_saved: Advanced settings sent to the satellite.
abort.satellite_values_unknown: The satellite is not reporting its settings now (voice program off). Turn it on and try again.

error.wifi_failed: The new network did not work (or the satellite is offline); the previous one was kept.
error.one_active_word: At least one wake word must be active.
error.out_of_range: A value is outside the allowed range.
error.bad_type: A value has the wrong type.

set_wifi.name: Set Wi-Fi
set_wifi.description: Starts a Wi-Fi change on a satellite. It rolls back by itself if the new network does not work; the outcome appears in the logbook and in the Wi-Fi change sensor.

retry_provisioning.name: Retry provisioning
retry_provisioning.description: Redoes the provisioning steps that failed on a satellite.

set_setting.name: Set setting
set_setting.description: Changes a setting from the integration's or a satellite's settings forms. Leave the device empty for general settings.

device_id.name: Satellite
device_id.description: The satellite for an advanced setting; empty for a general setting.

key.name: Setting
key.description: For example reply_wait, or wakeword_friday_mode for a satellite.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new value (number, on/off or text).

models.title: Models
models.description: Model used by each role. Voice and Lucid apply from the next conversation or run; the brain restarts F.R.I.D.A.Y. only when no conversation is open. Embeddings model (read-only): {embeddings}.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: Applies to every satellite. Follow-up mode stays a per-satellite switch on each device page.

data.reply_wait: Close if no reply starts within

abort.server_unavailable: The F.R.I.D.A.Y. server is not connected.
abort.embeddings_unavailable: The server cannot change the embeddings model yet.
abort.satellite_values_unknown: No satellite is reporting its settings now (voice program off or disconnected). Turn one on and try again, so its current values are shown instead of factory defaults.

error.out_of_range: The value is outside the allowed range.
error.bad_type: The value has the wrong type.
